title: refactor(plugin-security): remove the retired catalog objects' write gates and the walled data door; report positions naming an unresolved set (C3 stage 8-post)
body:
Fixes #22975
Clause-②: no

The last slice of #22975 (C3 stages 7a ∥ 7b → 8-post, under #15204). Stage 8 retired the four security-catalog row objects (`sys_position`, `sys_permission_set`, `sys_position_permission_set`, `sys_capability`), and 7a and 7b deleted the modules that wrote them. This PR removes what only guarded those writes, adds the report class ruled in #23229 → B, re-tightens the test spans the stage-8 test half loosened, and corrects the texts that still named the deleted objects and modules.

## What changes

**`@objectstack/plugin-security`**
- Three security-middleware gates on the retired objects are removed, with their call sites and cases: the package-provenance gate on `sys_permission_set`, the platform/package row gate on `sys_position`/`sys_capability` (with `SYSTEM_ROW_PROVENANCE`), and the curated capability-name gate on `sys_capability`. The delegated-administration gate drops its `sys_position_permission_set` and `sys_permission_set` cases. It still governs `sys_user_position`, `sys_user_permission_set` and `sys_member`, and `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts` keeps its direct-grants describe (`sys_user_permission_set`, nine cases) unchanged.
- `SecurityPlugin.assertAudienceAnchorBindingGate`, the fourth gate on the retired objects, is not in this diff: #23412 (`be50633be1`, closing #23403) deleted it on `main` together with the ADR-0138 text that named it. The merge of `main` took that deletion; the `security-plugin.ts` conflict was resolved by dropping both sides.
- `walled-catalog-data-door.ts` is deleted, with its ADR-anchor JSON and row 55b's data-door clause in `system-context.mdx`. Measured on 7a's head: no non-test object definition registers any of the three objects it judged; only `__tests__/legacy-catalog-objects.testkit.ts` does. Nothing imported the module since stage 8.
- `PermissionSetNameConflictError` is retired, with its error-code-ledger row.
- The packaged-permission-set lock loses its insert-only text (a "choose a different name" variant only the retired data door's create raised). Both published signatures keep their `operation` parameter, so no export changes.
- **#23229 → B (director ruling 6145194655):** `catalog-reference-report.ts` gains a sixth class. It lists, per position, a position definition whose `permissionSets` names a set the catalog cannot resolve, with the owner package and the unresolved names. It reads `catalog.list('position')`. An unreadable answer, or one that is not a list, stops the report as `catalog-unreadable`. One `error` line per boot. The class clears by itself on the next boot after the package is reinstalled.

**Re-tightened spans (S8-T follow-ups, 6140398039)**, each now exact on post-stage-8 `main`:
- `cleanup-package-permissions`: `toEqual` on the whole outcome; `refused` is `toBe(4)`; the control asserts that no grant is revoked.
- The two `kernel:bootstrapped` handler floors: `toHaveLength(2)`.
- The clone-route prescription pinned in full, with the `{ROUTE}` matcher removed.
- `wall-catalog-refusal`: `404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, with the objects' absence asserted.
- The clone-door dogfood asserts that no row object exists.
- `tenancy-by-object-classification`: no `global` entry; `sys_permission_set` reads `unclassified` and out of scope, and `sys_file` reads in scope.
- `uninstall-cleanups-runner`: `toEqual([[request]])`.

**Residue and prose**
- 7b's review (6150966333): `persistPositionBackfillRecord` is removed from both durability scripts, and the `position-row-definition.ts` JSDoc is corrected.
- 7a's review (6160232724, item 5) and the seat's later list: the comments, descriptions and evidence that named the deleted modules are corrected or put in the past tense. That covers the spec docblocks, the durability scripts, `access-security.json` (`:2602`, `:2633`, `:2649`), the core row-definition doc comments, plugin-security and plugin-sharing comments, metadata-protocol and plugin-auth test comments, and `tsconfig.test.json`. No ADR text is edited.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (comments only): the comments in `protocol.ts` that gave `permission` → `sys_permission_set` as a live example now give the examples registered today (`flow` for the publish materializer, `datasource` for the mutation projector, `sys_user_permission_set` for the uninstall cleanup), and the three delete-reset comments describe `sys_permission_set` as the case it was until stage 8. The changeset adds `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` as patch.
- **Q4 (ADR-0131 D3):** the `name` describes of `PositionSchema` and `PermissionSetSchema` say a name is unique within the security catalog the environment serves, replacing "unique per organization", which read the retired rows' index. Spec patch.
- Regenerated with the repo's tools: the spec references (`protocol.mdx`, `eval-user.mdx`, `position.mdx`, `permission.mdx`) and the `en` translation bundles.

## Carried, not in this PR
- **#23403, closed by #23412 (`be50633be1`, on `main`):** the removal of `assertAudienceAnchorBindingGate`, and the ADR text (ADR-0094, ADR-0103, ADR-0126, ADR-0131, ADR-0138) that named it or the deleted modules.
- **#23404:** `packages/spec/liveness/permission.json:20`. The `permission.description` evidence cites the retired row object and projection. No runtime reader of `PermissionSet.description` was found after 7a and S8, so it needs a liveness re-verification, not a prose fix.

## For the contract review
- **Q4:** the two "unique per organization" describes are restated to ADR-0131 D3: "unique within the security catalog the environment serves" (`PositionSchema.name` in `position.zod.ts`, `PermissionSetSchema.name` in `permission.zod.ts`).
- `packages/spec` is touched in describe text, doc comments and one ledger row: the exported `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` drops plugin-security's `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` row (the code stays registered by its other emitters). No key, type or schema shape moves. Changeset: `.changeset/15204-8post-catalog-gates-retired.md`, all patch (plugin-security, platform-objects, spec, core, metadata-protocol), `Clause-②: no`.

## Verification
Head `a338b13ce3`: this branch with `origin/main` `7b3d5585ca` merged (that merge brought #23412's deletion of the anchor gate; the `security-plugin.ts` conflict was resolved by dropping both sides), plus the post-merge prose commit, plus the lint fix `a338b13ce3`. That fix removes the orphaned block comment the merge resolution left in `security-plugin.ts`: a stray opener that swallowed two leftover closing braces of the retired anchor gate. The earlier merge (`5656c5638a`, after 7a's `dac99c2277`) stays in history. Delta against `main`: 63 files, +514 / −2,322 = 2,836 changed lines, generated files included. No governed path.
- On `a338b13ce3`: ESLint as CI runs it (`pnpm lint` flags) over the 53 changed source files exits 0; on `a33c341826`'s copy of the file the same command exits 1 at the orphan. `plugin-security` typecheck 0, and its suite 186/186 files, 3,701 passed (45 skipped).
- The rest below was measured on `a33c341826`, which differs from `a338b13ce3` only by those 4 deleted lines:
- `turbo build`: 76/76. No generated artifact was stale after the merge (`check:generated` clean).
- `plugin-security`: 186/186 files, 3,701 passed (45 skipped); typecheck 0.
- `metadata-protocol`: 235 files (3 skipped), 28,389 passed.
- `turbo typecheck` over the 9 touched packages (including `example-showcase`): 0.
- CLI integration tier: 127/127 files, 1,099 passed (2 skipped).
- `dispatch-gates --ran` with recorded exits: 147 derived, 147 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Non-zero:
  - `check:platform-checklist` exit 1: 8 reds, identical to the same gate on `main`;
  - `check-engine-split-ratio` exit 2: it refuses on this shallow clone.
- `check:adr-symbol-anchors` 0, and the other anchor sweeps 0.
- Dogfood was run on `c4e9c4f919`, before this merge: 257 files passed (1 skipped). The merge resolution touched no runtime code beyond `security-plugin.ts`, and this push touched only comments, so it was not re-run.
- Ablation of the new report class (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the per-position push replaced by `void`): 3 of 14 report tests red, then restored to the HEAD blob.

## Acceptance notes
- The retired `access-security.packaged-permission-set-lifecycle` item's title, `automated.ref`, `source` and the lines naming the deleted module are corrected here. Its other clauses still describe the retired data-door PATCH flow as they were written. Carrier: none.
- ADR-0090 D9 (`guest`) and D12 have no metadata-door counterpart pinned (NOT MEASURED). D5/D7 are pinned in `suggested-binding-acceptance.dogfood.test.ts`: the risky accept is refused, and `PUT /meta/position/everyone` answers 403.
- The objectui pinned sibling is NOT MEASURED: no sibling checkout exists in this container, and Console Pin Gate runs only in `main`'s full battery. No entry export of any package changes in this PR, so nothing objectui could import moves.
- `AdminScope.manageBindings` and `authorEnvironmentSets` are honoured by no write path once the delegated-admin catalog cases leave. The seat files this at landing (seat review 6124054616).
